title: At Davos, Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth says Superintelligence Labs delivered its first high-profile AI models internally this month and the models are "very good" (Jeffrey Dastin/Reuters)
summary: Jeffrey Dastin / Reuters: At Davos, Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth says Superintelligence Labs delivered its first high-profile AI models internally this month and the models are “very good” — Meta Platforms' (META.O) new artificial intelligence lab has delivered its first high-profile AI models internally this month …
